svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "Signal transduction: from receptor to response."], [1, "Reception: one ligand binds and changes the receptor's shape."], [2.5, "Transduction: activated molecules activate others..."], [5.5, "...each step multiplies the signal: amplification."], [9.5, "Response: the cell does something."]]
svg.title: Signal transduction and amplification
svg.desc: One ligand binds a receptor; a cascade inside the cell activates one, then three, then nine, then twenty-seven molecules, amplifying the signal into a cellular response.
svg.text: Each activated molecule activates several of the next (×3 shown; often far more).

g.data-info: The ligand binds the receptor, changing its shape.
A sequence of reactions inside the cell, often involving second messengers and enzymes that activate other enzymes.
Each activated molecule activates many of the next: one ligand molecule can lead to millions of product molecules.
e.g. channels open, enzymes are activated, vesicles move, or gene expression changes.

g.text: RESPONSE: channels open · enzymes activated · vesicles move · gene expression changes
